|errata_history=This is the original printing: the earliest PC card image of this card (8 July 2018). It is not the current version; the current version is [[There Is Another (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 8 July 2018<ref name="ht-L_thereisanother-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/thereisanother.gif thereisanother.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref>, no errata mark; lower-left name “Prisoner 2187”. Published two days after [[Virtual Set 9]] was released (6 July 2018), in the first commit of the PC's Holotable image set. Text: “Plays on Your Destiny unless Leia or Luke has been deployed this game (even as a captive). [Death Star II] Luke and We're The Bait are lost. Opponent's Objective and [Death Star II] Effects target Leia instead of Luke. Force loss from Take Your Father's Place is -1.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[There Is Another (Errata)]]): PC card image of 10 July 2022<ref name="ht-L_thereisanother-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6489b69/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/thereisanother.gif thereisanother.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69 6489b69] (10 July 2022, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>Virtual9-Light/hires/thereisanother.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/44c7bc5 44c7bc5] (10 July 2022, “Hi Res Sets 8 and 9”).</ref>, no errata mark; lower-left name “Prisoner 2187”. What changed from the previous version: re-rendered by the PC in its high-resolution card style (new frame, colours and typesetting) (high-resolution image committed the same day as “Hi Res Sets 8 and 9”); same words. No errata mark. The printed errata mark (none) does not match this version's place in the release order (change 1 of this card): recorded as a [[Players Committee transcription errors#Errata marks that do not match the version (Virtual Modern)|PC transcription error]]. Text: “Plays on Your Destiny unless Leia or Luke has been deployed this game (even as a captive). [Death Star II] Luke and We're The Bait are lost. Opponent's Objective and [Death Star II] Effects target Leia instead of Luke. Force loss from Take Your Father's Place is -1.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[There Is Another (Errata 2)]]): PC card image of 12 December 2022<ref name="ht-L_thereisanother-2">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/thereisanother.gif thereisanother.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca 12d0bca] (12 December 2022, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>Virtual9-Light/hires/thereisanother.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f9 e9980f9] (11 December 2022, “Set 20 Errata, 2020 AIs, and a few fixes”).</ref>, marked “E1”; lower-left name “Prisoner 2187”. What changed from the previous version: PC errata (high-resolution image committed 11 December 2022 as “Set 20 Errata, 2020 AIs, and a few fixes”; image marked “E1”): “[Death Star II] Luke and We're The Bait are lost.” becomes “We're The Bait is lost.”; “Force loss from Take Your Father's Place is -1.” is replaced by “Attempts to cross Leia over are -2. Opponent loses no Force to their Objective.” The Reflections III icon at the upper right is removed (the PC card data also records this: “Original had a Reflections III icon.”). The printed errata mark (“E1”) does not match this version's place in the release order (change 2 of this card): recorded as a [[Players Committee transcription errors#Errata marks that do not match the version (Virtual Modern)|PC transcription error]]. Text: “Plays on Your Destiny unless Leia or Luke has been deployed this game (even as a captive). We're The Bait is lost. Opponent's Objective and [Death Star II] Effects target Leia instead of Luke. Attempts to cross Leia over are -2. Opponent loses no Force to their Objective.”
Versions follow Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error.
